RUST_VERSION.description: Version of Rust demanded. Can be "nightly"|"beta"|"stable" xor a specific version

RUST_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install RUST. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

CARGO_NET_OFFLINE.description: Boolean flag ('true' or 'false') configuring Cargo to operate strictly offline.

CARGO_VENDOR_DIR.description: Directory path containing pre-vendored Cargo crates for offline builds.
